kjv: What burden? I will even forsake you
mine: You are the burden, and I will cast you off
note: MT 'et-mah-massa' "what burden?"; the LXX and Vulgate redivide the same consonants as 'attem hammassa' "you are the burden", making the pun (massa' = oracle / load) explicit; I follow the versions.

kjv: I, even I, will utterly forget you
mine: I will surely lift you up and cast you away
note: MT wenashiti 'etkhem nasho' "I will utterly forget you"; some Hebrew manuscripts and the versions read wenasa'ti ... nasa' "I will lift you up" (from nasa'), continuing the massa' pun. I follow the latter.
